tasks.short: Develop proposals and presentations for new work.

steps.what: Choose facts that could generate work opportunities.
Draft marketing materials, proposals and presentations.

loop.input: facts the architect marked usable, and no others
loop.output: proposal text that cites only those facts
loop.check: a sentence that adds a fact is discarded
loop.stop: one draft; a gap is left blank
loop.why_not_simpler: what the office is willing to claim is the edit

steps.what: Edit presentations before they leave the office.
Send the proposal the architect accepted.

tasks.design: The architect chooses which facts may be used. Marketing materials, proposals and presentations may cite only those facts. The architect edits them. {EMAIL} sends the accepted proposal. A picture in the draft, if it were generated rather than a project photograph, would be marked. This draft does not generate one. No new fact is added to win the work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Proposals were rewritten from the last one, and a claim survived that this job could not support.
tasks.enabler_now: A fact the architect marked usable can be repeated. Whether to claim it cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A prospect the office has no facts for, or a claim that overreaches, stays the edit.
tasks.human_edge: The architect knows which past job is fair to show.
tasks.altitude: Repeating chosen facts takes less rewriting. Choosing them and editing the proposal stay.

evidence.claim: A draft that repeats marked facts is a pack. It does not decide the claim.
The source pack says a generated image needs a mark. This proposal uses chosen facts and does not create a generated image. Other rules differ.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the architect develops and sends the proposal. Pricing a fee is a different task if a principal must set it.
Structured input: fact id, prospect id. Producer is the architect for which facts are usable. A sentence that adds a fact is discarded.
The edit stays. The draft does not invent a project.
unknowns: Are past projects recorded as citable facts?
research_questions: How often does a proposal repeat a claim from the previous prospect?

already_counted.description: Editing the proposal is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire drafts that were not sent.

approvals.approved_version: proposal the architect edited for that prospect

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If no facts are marked usable, the draft is empty and the architect still writes the proposal. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Gather sustainability and operational efficiency information.

steps.what: Search the projects for related information.
Gather information on environmental sustainability and operational efficiency.
File what was gathered on the project.

tasks.design: Indexed project records can be searched. Gathering information on environmental sustainability and operational efficiency stays the architect's reading and notes. {PROJECT} files those notes. A search hit is not a finding about the project.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sustainability notes were collected from several folders at the start of each job.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored record can be found. What it means for this project cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A record that does not apply, or a figure the office has never measured, stays the gathering.
tasks.human_edge: The architect knows which past figure is comparable and which is not.
tasks.altitude: Searching indexed records takes less hunting. Gathering and judging what applies stay.

evidence.claim: A search of indexed records is a query. Gathering what applies to this project is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the architect gathers project information. An energy calculation is a different task and is not produced here.
Structured input: project id, record id, note. Producer is the store for the record and the architect for the note. A record that was not read is not filed as gathered.
Gathering time stays. The search does not conclude.
unknowns: Are sustainability records indexed by project?
research_questions: How often is the same efficiency figure reused on a project it does not fit?

already_counted.description: Gathering what applies is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire notes when the project brief changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If records are not indexed, the search is empty and the architect still gathers from the folders. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Represent clients in bids and contract awards.

steps.what: Collect bids for obtaining a comparison.
Compare bid figures that are already rows.
Represent clients in awarding construction contracts.
Send the award the architect decided.

tasks.design: Bids that arrive as figures are collected and compared. Representing the client in obtaining bids and awarding the construction contract stays the architect, on the client's instruction. {EMAIL} sends only the award the architect decided. The lowest figure is not an award.
tasks.previous_blocker: Bids were compared on a sheet, and the award was a conversation the others did not see.
tasks.enabler_now: Figures in rows can be compared. Who should be awarded the contract cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A bid that is not comparable, or a client instruction that is not the lowest price, stays the representation.
tasks.human_edge: The architect knows which exclusion makes a low bid the wrong one.
tasks.altitude: Comparing figured bids takes less retotaling. Representing the client and deciding the award stay.

evidence.claim: Comparing figures that are already rows is arithmetic. Awarding a construction contract is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the architect represents the client and sends the decided award. Signing the contract is a different task if the client must sign.

Structured input: bidder id, price, exclusion, client instruction. Producer is the bid for the figures and the architect for the award. A bid that is not in rows is not compared, and the lowest price is not sent as an award.
Representation time stays. The comparison does not award.
unknowns: Do bids arrive as comparable figures?
research_questions: How often is a low bid awarded before its exclusions are read?

already_counted.description: Representing the client is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire comparisons after the award is sent or refused.

approvals.approved_version: award the architect decided for that bid set

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If bids are prose, nothing is compared and the architect still represents the client. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare operating manuals, studies and reports.

steps.what: List equipment the model already names.

loop.input: equipment ids the model names and the manual sections in the library
loop.output: a manual that cites only those ids
loop.check: a step that does not trace to an equipment id or a library section is discarded
loop.stop: one draft; a missing equipment item is marked absent
loop.why_not_simpler: whether the manual matches the building is the check

steps.what: Check studies and reports against the building.
Issue the manual the architect accepted.

tasks.design: Equipment the model names is listed. Operating and maintenance manuals, studies and reports may cite only that equipment and the library sections. The architect checks them against the building. {PROJECT} issues the accepted manual. A step that does not trace is not written in.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manuals were copied from the last building and the equipment names were wrong.
tasks.enabler_now: A named piece of equipment can be listed. Whether the manual matches this building cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Equipment the model does not name, or a study the library does not cover, stays the check.
tasks.human_edge: The architect knows which system the operator will actually face.
tasks.altitude: Listing named equipment takes less copying. Checking the manual against the building stays.

evidence.claim: A manual that cites named equipment and library sections is a draft. The source pack describes documents drafted from the model, with the architect signing. This is the pattern, not a measured case here.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the architect prepares the manual. The operator's training is a different task.
Structured input: equipment id, library section id. Producer is the model and the library. A step that does not trace is discarded.
The check is remaining time. The issue is the accepted manual only.
unknowns: Does the model name the equipment?
research_questions: How often does a manual describe a system the building does not have?

already_counted.description: Checking the manual is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire drafts when the model revision changes.

approvals.approved_version: manual the architect accepted for that building

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the model names no equipment, the draft is empty and the architect still writes the manual. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Proposals repeat only facts the architect chose, and the edit happens before anything is sent. Sustainability notes are gathered, not concluded by a search. Bid figures can be compared. The award stays a representation of the client.
reach: A prospect receives the sent proposal, not the draft.
A contractor receives an award only after it was decided.
skills_to_grow: Leave a gap blank rather than inventing a project fact.
Do not treat the lowest bid as the award.
role.ambitious_version: A proposal does not carry a claim from the previous prospect, and a bid that is not in rows is not compared.
